notes.title: June Update: New Unit Upgrade System & Balance Changes
notes.notes:
Rise to the occasion!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45328926/6f8b1a6833ffabb0eb71401d594016bb4052146b.gif

Heya all! We're back for a smaller update for Oath of the Necromancer.
It includes Settings, save data, quality-of-life changes, and Version 1 of the new Unit Upgrade System - to give a taste of what's to come: 

A full overhaul of the stats & upgrade system. 

The goal is to let you play how you want. Have every single possible unit in your army? Or invest everything into the Skeleton Troll? The update already goes in that direction, until the full overhaul hits live for the next patch.

In the meantime, we rebalanced the game to a more challenging degree. We hope it raises decision-making, learning the map, and intense, nerve-racking moments!

We added a lot more behind-the-scenes stuff, that we can't wait to show off in the future :)

Let us know what you think! We re always looking to include your opinions in the game development. You can do so here in the forum, or over on our Discord

The path is LIVE NOW

As always, thanks for playing, Oathkeepers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45328926/425863ab30f9201be556838324f534ac5e21a3dc.gif

notes.title: Mid-April Patch: Balance & Refinement
notes.notes:
Heya all! We're back with a big update. We listened to your feedback and are here to deliver!
The update focuses on making the game more fun, allow for more variety in gameplay, and a reworked final boss!
With the latest balance patch, we expect the famous 8 minute enemy rush to be a tad bit less difficult (Apologies for that!).

The full patch notes are on the Discord

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45328926/e783269ace53e017eef8194443624ee4ff6eada0.png

What's next?
We are planning to add more relics, more interesting upgrades, and more playable heroes!
And that's where we want to include you, too! Let us know what fantasy you want to explore in this game. We are always discussing decisions and choices on the Discord, and here on the forums. Voice your opinion and be heard! :)

As always, thank you for playing! You are the heart of the game <3
